patulin.translation:
n. 棒曲霉素
[化] 展开青霉素; 棒曲霉素

patulous.definition:
a. Open; expanded; slightly spreading; having the parts
   loose or dispersed; as, a patulous calyx; a patulous cluster of
   flowers.
patulous.translation:
a. 开展的, 扩展的, 张开的, 张口状的
[医] 开放的, 扩展的

patupaiarehe.translation: [网络] 帕图派尔瑞西；帕图派亚里希族
